submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"

finding.headline: "The First 72 Hours Home Alone After a C-Section"
finding.problem: "I came home from major surgery with a newborn and no one. I cried because I couldn't get out of bed to reach the baby's cot. The hospital sent me home like I was fine."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"
finding.person: A 29-yr-old Nigerian diaspora mom in Manchester whose husband returns to work in 9 days, omugwo never arrived (visa delay), and who cannot sit up, stand, or pick up her crying newborn without searing incision pain.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product → also anchor of the hidden-market "operating system."". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
